routes.label: Use equal distances from the mirror line

question: The point in the \(xy\)-plane with coordinates \((1000, 2012)\) is reflected across the line \(y=2000.\) What are the coordinates of the reflected point?
solution:
A reflection places the image the same perpendicular distance on the opposite side of the mirror line. Because \(y=2000\) is horizontal, this movement is vertical, so the \(x\)-coordinate stays \(1000\).

The original point is \(2012-2000=12\) units above the line. Its image is therefore \(12\) units below it, with
\[y=2000-12=1988.\]
The reflected point is \(\boxed{(1000,1988)}\), choice B.
